gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies that the affine interpolation of circle-valued maps is not well defined without coherent global real lifts, that per-loop lift choices need not agree, and that the required global lift/nullhomotopy argument is missing. This is the same defect as the gold representative dependence and unsupported converse homotopy construction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proposed homotopy requires a globally coherent lift of f/g; equality of winding data alone does not establish that lift, so the displayed interpolation may depend on representatives and fail to define the required continuous map.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed circle-valued interpolation is representative-dependent/not well defined, and the converse requires an unproved global real lift of f/g to obtain a continuous homotopy.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly gives the representative/lift ambiguity, failure of agreement at shared points, absence of a global lift, and the resulting unsupported extension and converse classification.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 diagnoses an opposite-direction or incorrectly indexed sheet-gluing identification that makes the covering function inconsistent. It does not diagnose the distinct defect that the successor cycle used for the jump may not be homologous to the prescribed cycle gamma_i under the stated embedding assumptions, nor the missing proof of equal winding.
